page_title: BUR 1-1 WOL | Burnley v Wolves 02/04/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' The match has just finished.
90+3' Joao Gomes (Wolves) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Thomas Bramall had an easy-decision to make.
90+2' Rayan Ait-Nouri (Wolves) is clearly in an offside position and the linesman raises his flag.
90+1' Boubacar Traore (Wolves) starts his run too early and the referee blows for offside.
90' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
90' Burnley take a short corner kick.
88' A goal, which was scored by Wilson Odobert (Burnley), was disallowed due to offside.
86' Here's the change. Lyle Foster leaves the pitch and Benson Manuel Hedilazio (Burnley) comes on as a substitute.
86' Sander Berge (Burnley) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
83' Gary O'Neil prepares a substitution. Pablo Sarabia is replaced by Boubacar Traore (Wolves).
80' Wonderful movement by Burnley. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
78' Burnley have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
76' It's time for a substitution. Matheus Cunha (Wolves) comes on in place of Leon Chiwome.
76' Wilson Odobert (Burnley) does well to control a poor pass on the edge of the box then shoots low towards the middle of the goal. Jose Sa is out of position but leaps to make a brilliant save.
74' Jay Rodriguez (Burnley) gives away a foul during an attacking move and the referee blows his whistle.
74' The attendance for today's match is 21528.
73' It is time for a substitution. Jay Rodriguez (Burnley) is on for Jacob Bruun Larsen.
72' Lyle Foster (Burnley) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
72' Burnley can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
70' Matt Doherty (Wolves) feels very aggrieved after the referee stops play for a foul that he commits while in possession of the ball.
70' Pablo Sarabia (Wolves) tries to send a low pass into the box, but it's blocked and cleared.
68' Substitution. Hugo Bueno leaves the pitch and is replaced by Santiago Bueno (Wolves).
68' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Wolves was in an offside position.
67' Burnley take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
64' Matt Doherty (Wolves) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
64' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Wolves comes to nothing.
63' Pablo Sarabia (Wolves) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
63' Jacob Bruun Larsen (Burnley) finds himself in an offside position and the referee stops play after the linesman raises his flag.
60' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Charlie Taylor (Burnley), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
60' Wilson Odobert (Burnley) unleashes a close-range volley towards the left side of the goal, but his effort is thwarted by the keeper, and the score remains unchanged.

58' Jacob Bruun Larsen (Burnley) gets on the end of a cross inside the box and sweeps the ball goalwards towards the right side of the goal, but Jose Sa is well positioned and easily deals with the effort.
57' Sander Berge (Burnley) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
56' Burnley quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
54' Nelson Semedo (Wolves) picked up a yellow card for talking out of turn to the referee. He has to be careful for the remainder of the match.

53' Rayan Ait-Nouri (Wolves) goes on a mazy run, skips past two defenders and pulls the trigger in front of the keeper. Arijanet Muric makes a decent save to deny his effort directed to the middle of the target.
51' Vitinho (Burnley) produces a lovely chip pass into the box, but one of the opposition players cuts it out.
50' The corner is swung in but Burnley can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
48' Charlie Taylor (Burnley) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
46' An attempted cross from Charlie Taylor (Burnley) is cleared.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+6' The end of the first half.
45+5' Thomas Bramall sticks with his original decision after the VAR review. No infringement and the goal stands!
45+5' The Wolves players halt their celebrations as referee Thomas Bramall makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.
45+3' 1 - 1 The ball is whipped in from the resulting set piece and finds the head of Rayan Ait-Nouri (Wolves) who rises and produces an amazing header into the bottom right corner.
45+2' David Datro Fofana (Burnley) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
45+2' Josh Cullen (Burnley) picks up a wayward pass but gives away possession by shooting from distance. The ball went miles wide of the right post.
45' 3 additional min. will be played.
42' Charlie Taylor (Burnley) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
41' Jacob Bruun Larsen (Burnley) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.
39' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Wolves.

37' 1 - 0 Goal! Jacob Bruun Larsen (Burnley) shows good awareness inside the box as he latches on to a brilliant pass and fires a first-time shot into the bottom left corner. Dara O'Shea assisted in the goal. 1:0.
35' David Datro Fofana (Burnley) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
34' Vitinho (Burnley) meets a pass on the edge of the penalty area and shoots towards the middle of the goal. He didn't put enough power into the effort, though, and Jose Sa pulls off an easy save.
33' Joao Gomes (Wolves) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
32' The game is interrupted now, Joao Gomes (Wolves) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
28' Thomas Bramall blows his whistle after Max Kilman (Wolves) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle.
27' Joao Gomes (Wolves) blows a golden opportunity from inside the 6-yard box. He pounces on the rebound to head the ball just wide of the left post.
27' Pablo Sarabia (Wolves) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.
26' Rayan Ait-Nouri (Wolves) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
23' Matt Doherty (Wolves) takes a neat pass, dummies a defender and slams the ball well wide of the left post from the edge of the box.
23' Wolves failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
22' Rayan Ait-Nouri (Wolves) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
19' Thomas Bramall blows his whistle after Nelson Semedo (Wolves) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball.
18' Vitinho (Burnley) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
17' Half-chance! David Datro Fofana (Burnley) plays a pass into the box, but Jose Sa reacts well to snuff out the attack.
15' Dara O'Shea (Burnley) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows for a foul after seeing the whole situation.
13' David Datro Fofana (Burnley) slips past one challenge, but is unable to feed a low pass into the path of one of his teammates.
12' Vitinho (Burnley) attempts to find one of his teammates inside the box with a chip pass, but one of the defending players reacts superbly and intercepts the ball.
11' A pass by Sander Berge (Burnley) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
10' Wilson Odobert (Burnley) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
9' The free kick from long range, taken by Burnley, is intercepted by one of the defenders.

9' Rayan Ait-Nouri (Wolves) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Thomas Bramall blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion.
8' Dara O'Shea (Burnley) sends a long ball across the pitch, but it misses its target. The ball goes out of play and Wolves will have a goal kick.
7' Wilson Odobert (Burnley) receives a good pass and from just outside the box he unleashes a promising strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
6' Jose Sa steps in and intercepts a long pass from Maxime Esteve (Burnley).
4' Wolves keep possession of the ball by producing short passes and one-two passes from player to player.
3' Charlie Taylor (Burnley) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.

1' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Burnley are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are on the pitch and Burnley will have the kick-off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Thomas Bramall.
